It should be installed in the middle of the two F Holes. 2. When you receive the bow and the hairs are loose, don't worry. Use the screw to tighten the frog so that the hair has tautness. 3. When you find that part of the bow hair is broken, it is normal, please cut off the broken part and the bow can be used normally. 4. Be careful to not over tighten your bow. Hold the rosin with your index finger and thumb, and thus tighten up the bow, evenly smear the rosin on the bowstring up and down. Suggested use: before smearing, rip a trace on rosin to make it powdery for quick and even smearing. Try to keep your hands away from rosin or pad with a tissue while smearing; otherwise it will become too sticky to clean. 6. Side pocket for storage space

This sofa combines practical features with modern aesthetics – the side storage pocket holds a remote control, magazines, snacks or mobile phones, so everyday essentials are always within reach, yet discreetly concealed. The bag is seamlessly integrated into the lines of the frame, maintaining the clean silhouette and adding a touch of rational order to the space.

Modular seat cushions

Each seat cushion of this sofa is an independent module – easy to separate and recombine. This is how you define its shape depending on the situation: as a large family couch for socializing, as a comfortable lying surface for naps, or as individual seats for flexible use of space. Whether it's a movie night with an enclosing seating area, spontaneous overnight guests or a reading corner in everyday life: it meets every requirement with gentle intelligence.

Fully vacuum-compressed sofa

Innovative full vacuum packaging – unfolds automatically and without tools to a complete shape after unpacking. In minutes, it transforms from a compact package into a comfortable sofa: just position it and relax immediately. Difficult installation, lost screws and incomprehensible instructions are a thing of the past. With effortless handling and quick integration into the living room, study or bedroom.

Versatile use

With its highly flexible design, this sofa breaks the boundaries of conventional furniture: as an orderly seating area for social gatherings, can be transformed into a guest bed for overnight stays in a flash, or as a spacious play zone for children. Whether as the centrepiece in the living room, a multifunctional solution in the office for lunch breaks and reception, or as a space miracle in the student apartment – its intelligent adaptability makes it a universal companion for a wide range of life scenarios.

Easy maintenance

The easy-care fabric cover is pleasantly soft, durable and easy to clean - ideal for daily use with children or pets. Whether for a spontaneous family movie night or improvised living room camping - it fits easily into any situation and becomes a reliable companion for shared moments full of laughter and cosiness.

Stylish & functional

More than just a piece of furniture – an intelligent room concept for the modern, mobile lifestyle. Whether it's frequent tenant moves, annual changes of residence by students or seasonal use in small urban apartments: it integrates into your life in the "easiest" way – easy to transport when moving, almost invisible to store and ready for use in a flash. Space blends in with life, not the other way around – the perfect solution for a mobile generation.

products.title: Bohemian-style Neck-wrap Vacation Dress
products.body_html:
Relaxed Silhouette
A loose A-line shape combined with a waist-draped pleat design flatters all body types, effectively concealing curves and creating a slimming effect. Its flowing drape adds an effortlessly elegant touch, making it perfect for various casual settings such as vacations, beaches, and markets.

Contrasting Detail Design
A deep V-neckline paired with vibrant orange trims along the sides and hem brightens the overall look against a neutral gray base. This retro-chic combination creates eye-catching style while subtly elongating the neck line.

Breathable, Skin-Friendly Fabric
Made from lightweight, slightly crinkled sheer fabric that offers excellent breathability and prevents sweat buildup. With a soft drape and subtle texture, it feels cool and comfortable in summer, evoking a laid-back vacation vibe.

Functional Details
Hidden side pockets provide convenient storage for phones, lipsticks, and small essentials. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit, accommodating different shoulder shapes for greater comfort.

Versatile Styling Options
Wear it solo as a standout summer dress or layer over cardigans or denim jackets. Paired with straw hats and woven bags, it easily transitions between bohemian, casual, and vintage styles.

products.title: Floral Lace Cut-Out Maxi Dress With Thigh-High Slit
products.body_html:
Product Details

Overview

The Nocturne Lace Gown is a masterpiece of dark romanticism and modern allure. Crafted from intricate floral guipure lace, this floor-sweeping silhouette features daring waist cut-outs and a dramatic thigh-high slit, balancing modest high-neck tailoring with contemporary edge. Designed for high-profile evening events, it creates a statuesque profile that is both timeless and provocative.

Design Features

  • Neckline: Elegant high-standing mandarin collar for a refined, regal look.

  • Sleeves: Delicate cap sleeves that provide minimal coverage while maintaining a structured shoulder line.

  • Cut-Outs: Symmetrical side-waist cut-outs designed to accentuate the natural curve of the waist.

  • Skirt: A slim-fit maxi skirt featuring a bold front slit for ease of movement and a hint of skin.

  • Back: Secure zip-back closure for a seamless, tailored fit.

Specifications

  • Material: Premium Corded Floral Lace (100% Nylon/Polyester blend).

  • Lining: Integrated nude-toned partial lining for a sheer-effect contrast and optimal coverage.

  • Stretch: Minimal stretch to maintain the structured lace pattern.

  • Length: Full-length maxi (approx. 60 inches from shoulder to hem).

Size & Fit

  • Fit: Slim fit through the bodice and hips. We recommend sizing up if you are between sizes.

  • Model Info: Model is 168cm, wearing a size Small.

Care Instructions

  • Professional dry clean only.

  • Store flat to avoid stretching the lace delicate fibers.

  • Keep away from sharp jewelry to prevent snagging.

Styling Tip

"Let the intricate lace be the focal point by pairing this gown with sleek pulled-back hair and statement gold drop earrings. Finish the look with minimalist black stiletto sandals for an elongated, elegant silhouette."

Descriptions

Classic thick flannel fabric, comfortable and versatile

The sofa is made of high-quality thick flannel, with soft texture and classic appearance. The fabric is skin-friendly, durable and not easy to fade. The neutral colours blend seamlessly with different interior styles – whether modern, rustic or minimalist, it gives your home a warm and cosy atmosphere. In addition, the thick flannel fabric is easy to clean: dust can be removed with a vacuum cleaner, light dirt can be carefully wiped off with a damp cloth.

High-density foam + suspension elements, long seating times without fatigue

Inside the sofa is high-density foam upholstery with high density and good rebound, combined with built-in spring elements. This combination makes for one that is soft but stable – not too soft to not support the body enough and not too hard to cause discomfort. It effectively reduces the strain on the spine, even when sitting or napping for hours on end. The spring elements also strengthen the stability of the sofa and extend its lifespan

Practical functional equipment, comfortable life

The sofa is equipped with large side compartments and integrated cup holders. The side compartments offer enough space for TV remote control, books, magazines, mobile phones or tablets - all within reach, without needing extra storage space. The cup holders prevent drinks from accidentally tipping over, ideal for movie nights, relaxation times or guest reception.

Comfortable for long working days

The sturdy construction and high-quality materials ensure a long lifespan even with intensive daily use. The cushions can be easily removed and cleaned separately (according to the material specifications). This sofa allows for long-lasting comfort without extensive maintenance - ideal for busy families or followers of a minimalist lifestyle.

Easy care in everyday life

In everyday life, we need furniture that is easy to maintain - and this sofa meets exactly that requirement! The thick flannel material is abrasion-resistant and resistant to light soiling. In case of dust, you can easily clean it with a vacuum cleaner; in the case of stains, wipe carefully only with a damp cloth - no time-consuming cleaning necessary.

Versatile applications, cost-effective choice

The compact sofa is suitable for almost any room and situation. Whether as a main seat in the living room, as a guest sofa in the guest room, as a work sofa in the home office or as an additional seating area for parties - it adapts flexibly. The simple and timeless design language does not make it obsolete quickly, and the high-quality materials ensure a long service life. Compared with traditional sofas, it is more space-saving and cost-effective, it does not provide less comfort.

Material: Edible Silicon (free of phenol A, lead, and known harmful substances), non-latex products, will not cause any allergic reactions to infants and children, you can use it with confidence!
Stage 1: in the budding stage, before the teeth grow out, the baby already feels uncomfortable on the gums. The gum of the first stage can be put in the refrigerator, and the cool touch can relieve the swelling and pain of the baby's gums before teething.
Stage 2: at the age of 6 months, most babies begin to grow a pair of incisors in the lower jaw. At this time, frozen gums massage soft incisors should be used to relieve discomfort; Hard gums can massage pulp, and uneven gum surface will also stimulate the development of baby's brain.
Stage 3: When the baby grows four upper and lower teeth, it is recommended to choose pacifier chewing gum which is similar in shape to pacifier, lighter in weight and easier to grasp. The soft and hard texture layer can not only massage the pulp around the newly grown teeth, but also let the baby experience the feeling of chewing.
The fourth stage: 1-2 years old. 1-2 years old is the growth period of deciduous teeth. Select the fixed teeth gums that can reach a wide range of teeth and have baffles to prevent contact with the throat. The texture layer mixed with soft and hard can reduce swelling and pain caused by big teeth, help to enhance tooth development and exercise chewing ability.

4. Loosen the fasteners, remove 1 end while being prepared to fight the pressure in the strut, move the end so it's away from the bodywork, remove the other end, install that end of the new 1, wrestle the other end into place and tighten up.
5. Make sure all connectors and hardware are in place, tight and secure. Reconnect electrical terminals at both ends of the gas-charged lift support, if applicable to your car. Retain plastic end caps, if applicable to your car.
